title: Review an interface with UX principles
author: TriunaLabs
origin: User-selected experimental workflow reviewed and enhanced for the TriunaLabs public library with an evidence model, validation, comparison, executable tests, portable references, and an annotated HTML report.
requirements: Python 3.10+ for validation, comparison, and poster rendering. A supplied screenshot, URL, HTML file, interaction trace, or clear surface description is required for grounded findings; URL and browser inspection depend on the tools and permissions available in the host environment.
examples: Review this mobile checkout using the smallest set of UX principles that explains the observed problems.
Turn these grounded findings into an annotated teardown poster and a testable engineering handoff.
Compare the before and after screenshots, preserving finding IDs and separating resolved, changed, new, and unchanged issues.

preview.alt: Annotated Laws of UX report with evidence-backed findings connected to regions of a mobile interface.
